_comment: Successions recorded by hand, by register name, where NHS ODS has none or dates one in a way that would mislead. ODS stays the source everywhere else. See pipeline/lineage.py and docs/plan-organisation-changes.md.

successions.evidence: reviewed: NHS Digital, legally the Health and Social Care Information Centre, merged into NHS England on 1 February 2023. ODS links HSCIC to NHS England from April 2013, which would mislabel the merger.
